value.rationale: Fourth-distance cube graph states are natural Hamming association-scheme models; a canonical coordinate cut exhibits four structurally distinct modular-entanglement classes, including maximal mixing and large deficits. The theorem determines the entire spectrum for exponentially many qubits and explains the phenomenon through a nonsemisimple characteristic-two operator. It is not just a textbook application of the generic cut-rank formula.
